problems: events/0 fixes -2600..-2501 but breaks -2500..-2340. Cells that a patch hands over before a year are no longer event-settled when the same land is regained in that year, so a later keyframe of an R2 'successor' takes them back. Fixing it needs a keyframe override of sumerian-city-states_-2500 (cut {place: Ur, km: 40}), which starts in window m2500-m2401; exact entry in checks[0].fix. The orchestrator must decide whether that cross-window override goes in m2600-m2501.json or m2500-m2401.json.

Root cause (dossier or compiler, not patchable): first-dynasty-of-ur lists the older collective sumerian-city-states (-3400) as its successor, so R2 (compile_dossiers.py decide(), line 914: ab = (b, a) in self.succ and y >= self.start[b]) makes the collective beat Ur for Ur's whole life. Two possible fixes. Dossier: also list first-dynasty-of-ur among sumerian-city-states' successors (when each lists the other, R2 picks the later-born, Ur), or drop the successor entry, since the -2340 handover is already booked by Ur's dissolve and the collective's gain. Compiler: apply R2 only from the predecessor's end year. Umma has the same pattern (m2500-m2401 events/0 works around it).
